records.packet_source_event: Speech to the Conservative Party Conference
records.quote_text: In the Conservative Party, we have no truck with outmoded Marxist doctrine about class warfare. For us, it is not who you are, who your family is or where you come from that matters. It is what you are and what you can do for our country that counts. That is our vision.

records.official_title: Speech to Conservative Party Conference ('the lady's not for turning') [“The Reason Why”]

records.official_title: Speech to Conservative Party Conference ('the lady's not for turning') [“The Reason Why”]

records.official_title: The Second Carlton Lecture ("Why democracy will last")
records.packet_source_event: Second Carlton Lecture
records.quote_text: Great political economists, the greatest of them Adam Smith, have shown how a market economy, by devolving the power of consumer choice to customers, runs with the grain of democracy, which disperses the power of political choice to voters.

records.official_title: Interview for Reader’s Digest
records.packet_source_event: Interview
records.quote_text: Socialism is not a creed of the people. Socialism is a doctrine of the intellectuals, a particular kind of intellectual who had the arrogance to believe that they could do it better than other people because they could plan everyone's lives.

records.official_title: Speech at the Conservative Party Conference (Pinochet's "Judicial Kidnap")
records.packet_source_event: Speech to the Hoover Institution
records.quote_text: We know what works - the Anglo-Saxon model of liberty, property, law and capitalism. And we know where it works - everywhere it's actually applied.

records.quote_text: I am interested in responsible trade unionism, responsible trade unionists prepared to build a prosperous industry, which comes from satisfying customers. And with a prosperous industry, we mean a fair deal for the people who work in it.
